description: Assign or override a member’s role on an Open Label project (ADMIN, MANAGER, REVIEWER, ANNOTATOR, ANNOTATOR_REVIEWER, VIEWER — the org owner is pinned). Requires open-label:write scope and the members_manage capability.

customRoleId.description: Org-defined capability bundle (from open_label_list_roles): becomes the effective capability set; omitting it with a plain roleKey clears any previous bundle.

roleKey.description: One of the assignable built-in role keys.

name: open_label_set_member_role
